quote: # Do not change exposed endpoints as other organisations might
issue: This is a code-level absence claim about MTDSim, and neither brown2023 nor zhang2023 states it. Brown says IP shuffle changes 'all the IP addresses of the internal hosts' (p. 3). In the released code (f13ed49), IP shuffle (ipshuffle.py:18), port shuffle (portshuffle.py:19), OS diversity (osdiversity.py:20) and service diversity (servicediversity.py:17) skip the exposed endpoints. User shuffle (usershuffle.py:15-20) does not: it redraws the users of every host, endpoints included, and its skip loop comes after the redraw and does nothing. The 'accounts' clause is therefore our repair (D-23, Marc 2026-08-27), not the inherited behaviour. Section 6.5 (thr:code) discloses repairs only in general.
fix_text: cite tay2024code for the inherited exemption, and mark the user-shuffle part as ours, e.g. 'keep their address, software and accounts throughout' -> '... and, since our repair of user shuffle, accounts throughout'; or leave the text and accept the general disclosure in Section 6.5
